# Panda Federation Tools: full reference for AI agents

> Research and public-data tools on Apify. Every batch tool writes one dataset item per result (with a one-line summary field: `summary` on the citation, literature, PubMed, PDF, NPI and expert tools, `agentSummary` on Grants Finder and the lead, audit, trends and monitoring tools) and a `SUMMARY` record in the run's key-value store with counts, a one-line `takeaway` and, where there is one, a `nextStep` pointing to the logical follow-on tool. Status, where used: OK = verified / safe, CHECK = read the note, FIX = do not use as written.

How to call: prefer a focused domain MCP server (stdio; e.g. `uvx --from panda-federation-tools panda-research-tools`, or `uvx panda-federation-tools` with `PFT_DOMAIN`; env `APIFY_TOKEN`; tool names below, each also takes optional `run_max_items`, `run_max_charge_usd` and `run_timeout_secs`; inputs are validated against the Actor's schema before any run), Apify MCP server `https://mcp.apify.com` (tool `call-actor`, Actor `pandadad0214/<slug>`), or `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/pandadad0214~<slug>/run-sync-get-dataset-items` with `Authorization: Bearer <Apify token>` and the JSON input as the body. Every input field in each Actor's input schema has a description with formats, units and limits. Pricing is pay per result; Apify Bronze, Silver and Gold plans get 10%, 20% and 30% off.

## Reference Checker

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/reference-checker
MCP tool (this repo): `reference_checker`
Use when: you need to verify that references are real, correctly cited and not retracted.
Input: `bibliography` (pasted reference list, any style), `dois` (list), `titles` (list); options `minMatchScore` (50 to 100, default 80), `checkOpenAccess`, `maxReferences` (1 to 20,000). `mode: "monitor"` with `dois` or `orcid` re-checks a list on a schedule and reports only new retractions.
Minimal input: `{"dois": ["10.1038/nature14539"]}`
Output per item: `summary`, `status` (OK/CHECK/FIX), `verdict`, `matchedDoi`, `matchScore`, `mismatches` (cited vs actual), `integrity.status` (none, retracted, corrected, expression-of-concern), `openAccessUrl`, `warnings`.
SUMMARY: `total`, `ok`, `check`, `fix`, `notFound`, `retracted`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`.
Price: $0.01 per reference checked.

## Citation Generator API

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/citation-formatter
MCP tool (this repo): `citation_formatter`
Use when: you need formatted citations from DOIs, ISBNs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs, titles or messy references.
Input: `references` (list), or `text` (pasted bibliography or .bib/.ris contents); `styles` (apa, mla, chicago, harvard, ieee, vancouver), `includeBibtex`, `includeRis`, `maxReferences`.
Minimal input: `{"references": ["10.1038/nature14539"], "styles": ["apa"]}`
Output per item: `summary`, `status`, one field per style (`apa`, `mla`, ...), `inText`, `bibtex`, `ris`, `doi`, `title`, `authors`, `year`, `containerTitle`.
SUMMARY: `total`, `formatted`, `ok`, `check`, `unresolved`, `duplicates`, `files`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Key-value records: `BIBLIOGRAPHY_<STYLE>`, `BIBLIOGRAPHY_BIBTEX`, `BIBLIOGRAPHY_RIS`.
Price: $0.003 per formatted citation.

## Google Scholar Scraper Alternative (Literature Search)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/literature-search
MCP tool (this repo): `literature_search`
Use when: you need real papers on a topic or around seed papers.
Input: `query` (words or Boolean, quotes for phrases) and/or `seedDois` with `seedMode`; `yearFrom`/`yearTo` (years), `minCitations`, `openAccessOnly`, `types`, `sortBy`, `maxResults` (1 to 2,000), `citationStyle`.
Minimal input: `{"query": "retrieval augmented generation clinical", "maxResults": 20}`
Output per item: `summary`, `status`, `title`, `authors`, `year`, `venue`, `doi`, `citations`, `readingRank`, `readingScore`, `isOpenAccess`, `pdfUrl`, `retracted`, `citation`, `bibtex`, `ris`, `abstract`.
SUMMARY: `returned`, `totalMatches`, `counts`, `openAccess`, `withPdf`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `READING_LIST`, `RESULTS_XLSX`, `RESULTS_CSV`, `REFERENCES_BIBTEX`, `REFERENCES_RIS`.
Price: $0.003 per paper returned.

## PubMed Scraper (Evidence Table)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/pubmed-evidence-table
MCP tool (this repo): `pubmed_evidence_table`
Use when: you need PubMed studies for a review in an evidence table.
Input: `queries` (list of PubMed search strings, field tags allowed), `dateFrom`/`dateTo` (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), `studyDesigns`, `excludeAnimalOnly`, `languages`, `retractedArticles` (flag or exclude), `maxResults` (1 to 10,000), `citationStyle`.
Minimal input: `{"queries": ["semaglutide[tiab] AND obesity[tiab]"], "maxResults": 20}`
Output per item: `summary`, `status`, `pmid`, `title`, `year`, `journal`, `studyDesign`, `sampleSize`, `sampleSizeConfidence`, `retractionStatus`, `retracted`, `citation`.
SUMMARY: `returned`, `prisma`, `counts`, `studyDesigns`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `EVIDENCE_TABLE_XLSX`, `PRISMA_COUNTS`, `REVIEW_IMPORT_RIS`, `REVIEW_IMPORT_RAYYAN_CSV`.
Price: $0.004 per article returned.

## Grants.gov Scraper (Grants Finder)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/grants-finder
MCP tool (this repo): `grants_finder`
Use when: you need open or forecasted US federal grant opportunities, or funded NIH and NSF awards.
Input: `keywords` (required), `sources` (grants_gov, nih, nsf), `maxResultsPerSource` (1 to 1,000), `agencies`, `dateFrom`/`dateTo` (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), `minAmount`/`maxAmount` (USD), `grantsGovStatuses`, `sortBy`.
Minimal input: `{"keywords": "rural broadband", "maxResultsPerSource": 10}`
Output per item: `agentSummary` (one line), `source`, `recordType`, `status`, `title`, `agency`, `number`, `openDate`, `closeDate`, `amount` (USD), `eligibility`, `summary` (the grant's own description), `url`.
SUMMARY: `returned`, `bySource`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `GRANTS_XLSX`, `GRANTS_CSV`.
Price: $0.003 per result.

## Academic Research MCP Server

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/panda-research-mcp
Use when: an AI agent should call research tools directly over MCP.
Endpoint: `https://pandadad0214--panda-research-mcp.apify.actor/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer <Apify token>`).
Tools: `check_references` (up to 10 references), `format_citations` (up to 10 items, one style), `search_literature` (up to 20 papers), `pubmed_evidence_table` (up to 20 articles).
Output: JSON with `results`, a one-line `takeaway`, status OK/CHECK/FIX where it applies, and a `bulk` link to the standalone Actor for larger jobs.
Price: $0.01 per reference tool call, $0.02 per search tool call; failed or empty calls are free.

## PDF Table Extractor (PDF to Excel & CSV)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/pdf-table-extractor
MCP tool (this repo): `pdf_table_extractor`
Use when: you need every table in a PDF extracted to Excel and CSV, with OCR for scanned pages.
Input/output: PDF URLs or uploads in; one item per table (pages, header, row and column counts, cell data, `summary`) plus Excel and CSV files out.
Price: $0.001 per PDF page analysed, plus $0.003 per table extracted and $0.02 per scanned page OCRed (only when ocrScannedPages is on). PDFs that cannot be fetched cost nothing.

## USAspending Scraper (Federal Contract Finder)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/federal-contract-finder
MCP tool (this repo): `federal_contract_finder`
Use when: you need US federal contract awards, the incumbents in a market, or contracts whose period of performance ends soon (recompete leads).
Input: `mode` (awards or recompete), `keywords`, `naicsCodes`, `pscCodes`, `agencies` (name or abbreviation, e.g. DOD, VA, Department of the Army), `performanceStates`, `setAsides` (SBA, 8A, HZC, SDVOSBC, WOSB…), `recipientNames`, `recompeteMonths` (1 to 36), `dateFrom`/`dateTo`, `minAmount`/`maxAmount`, `maxResults` (1 to 5,000), `sortBy`. At least one filter is required.
Minimal input: `{"mode": "recompete", "naicsCodes": ["541512"], "recompeteMonths": 12, "maxResults": 20}`
Output per item: `agentSummary` (one line), `awardId`, `recipientName`, `recipientUei`, `amount` (USD), `awardingAgency`, `awardingSubAgency`, `naicsCode`, `pscCode`, `description`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `monthsLeft`, `status`, `performanceState`, `url`.
SUMMARY: `returned`, `totalAmount`, `endingWithin12Months`, `topRecipients`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `CONTRACTS_XLSX` (with a Top recipients sheet), `CONTRACTS_CSV`.
Price: $0.002 per contract returned.

## Email Domain Security Checker

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/email-domain-security-checker
MCP tool (this repo): `email_domain_security_checker`
Use when: you need an email deliverability and spoofing audit of one or many domains (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, MX provider).
Input: `domains` (domains, email addresses or URLs; cleaned and de-duplicated), `maxDomains` (1 to 10,000), `dkimSelectors` (extra selectors to test besides about 40 common ones).
Minimal input: `{"domains": ["example.org", "sales@example.com"]}`
Output per item: `agentSummary`, `domain`, `grade` (A to F), `score` (0-100), `spoofable`, `mailProvider`, `spfRecord`, `spfAll`, `spfLookups`, `dmarcRecord`, `dmarcPolicy`, `dmarcReporting`, `dkimSelectorsFound`, `mtaSts`, `tlsRpt`, `bimi`, `mxHosts`, `fixes` (prioritized), `status`.
SUMMARY: grade counts, `spoofable`, `mailProviders`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `DOMAINS_XLSX` (Domains + Fixes sheets), `DOMAINS_CSV`. Nonexistent or unresolvable domains are returned free.
Price: $0.002 per domain checked.

## AI Search & SEO Audit

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/ai-search-seo-audit
MCP tool (this repo): `ai_search_seo_audit`
Use when: you need technical SEO and AI-search (GEO) readiness checks for pages or a small site, including AI crawler access in robots.txt, structured data and llms.txt.
Input: `urls` (pages or sites), `crawlInternalLinks` (0 to 100 extra same-site pages per start URL), `maxPages` (1 to 2,000), `generateLlmsTxt` (true/false).
Minimal input: `{"urls": ["https://example.com"], "crawlInternalLinks": 10}`
Output per item: `agentSummary`, `url`, `seoScore`, `aiReadinessScore` (0-100 each), `title`, `metaDescription`, `h1`, `wordCount`, `schemaTypes`, `faqSchema`, `aiSearchBotsBlocked`, `aiTrainingBotsBlocked`, `llmsTxt`, `sitemapFound`, `canonical`, `noindex`, `crawlerBlocked`, `fixes` (ranked).
SUMMARY: average scores, sites blocking AI crawlers, sites without llms.txt, weakest page, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `AUDIT_XLSX` (Pages, Fixes, Sites), `AUDIT_CSV`, `LLMS_TXT_DRAFTS`. Pages that block the crawler are returned free.
Price: $0.004 per page audited.

Use when: you need local businesses of a type in a place (city, county, ZIP or radius) with contact details, under an open license (OpenStreetMap, ODbL).

Price: $0.001 per business returned.

MCP tool (this repo): `company_hiring_signals`
Use when: you need a hiring-intent signal per company: whether it is hiring, how fast, for which teams, and whether leadership roles are open (sales triggers, recruiting leads, competitor watch).

Minimal input: `{"companies": ["stripe.com", "Notion"], "titleKeywords": ["SDR"]}`
Output per item: `agentSummary`, `company`, `domain`, `signal` (hot/warm/cold/none), `hiringScore` (0-100), `openJobs`, `newJobs7d`, `newJobs30d`, `leadershipJobs`, `leadershipTitles`, `topFunctions`, `functionCounts`, `remoteShare`, `topLocations`, `keywordHits`, `newestJobs`, `lastPostedAt`, `ats`, `boardUrl`, `matchedBy`, `status`.
SUMMARY: `signals`, `hot`, `notFound`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `HIRING_XLSX` (Companies + every open job), `COMPANIES_CSV`, `JOBS_CSV`. Companies without a public board are returned free.
Price: $0.003 per company returned.

## Topic Trends Tracker (Google Trends alternative)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/topic-trends-tracker
MCP tool (this repo): `topic_trends_tracker`
Use when: you need to compare public interest in topics, brands, products or people with real numbers over time, without Google Trends rate limits (Wikimedia pageviews API, data from July 2015).
Input: `topics` (words or Wikipedia links; redirects followed, disambiguation skipped), `months` (1 to 120), `language` (Wikipedia edition, default en), `device` (all/desktop/mobile), `excludeBots` (default true), `includeDailySeries`, `maxTopics`.
Minimal input: `{"topics": ["ChatGPT", "Ozempic"], "months": 12}`
Output per item: `agentSummary`, `topic`, `article`, `url`, `interestIndex` (0-100), `trend` (surging/rising/flat/falling), `totalViews`, `avgDailyViews`, `last30dViews`, `change30dPct`, `yoyChangePct`, `peakDate`, `peakViews`, `spikes`, `monthlyViews`, optional `dailyViews`.
SUMMARY: `ranking`, `notFound`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `TRENDS_XLSX` (Topics, Monthly and Daily sheets with one column per topic), `TOPICS_CSV`, `DAILY_CSV`. Topics without an article are free.
Price: $0.002 per topic tracked.

## Company Team & Decision-Maker Finder

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/company-team-finder
MCP tool (this repo): `company_team_finder`
Use when: you need the people behind companies (leaders, decision makers, staff) with titles from each company's own public website: team, leadership, about, staff, attorney and partner pages (robots.txt respected, no LinkedIn scraping, no logins).

Minimal input: `{"companies": ["sparkbox.com"], "decisionMakersOnly": true}`

SUMMARY: `companies` (status, team pages, email pattern per company), `topPeople`, `decisionMakers`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `PEOPLE_XLSX` (People + Companies), `PEOPLE_CSV`. Companies with no readable team page, and people removed by filters, are free.
Price: $0.002 per person returned.

## Website Change Monitor

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/website-change-monitor
MCP tool (this repo): `website_change_monitor`
Use when: you need to know if public web pages changed since the previous check, and what changed. Snapshots are kept in the caller's own Apify account (key-value store `panda-change-monitor-<monitorName>`), so repeated calls with the same `monitorName` compare against the last call.
Input: `urls` (one per line, optional label after " | "), `monitorName`, `watchKeywords`, `cssSelector`, `ignorePatterns` (regex), `ignoreNumbersAndDates`, `minChangePercent`, `onlyReportChanges`, `webhookUrl` (https; POSTed only when pages changed), `maxPages`.
Minimal input: `{"urls": ["https://example.com/pricing"], "monitorName": "my-watch"}`
Output per item: `agentSummary`, `url`, `label`, `status` (baseline saved / changed / unchanged / unchanged (below threshold) / error), `changed`, `changePercent`, `addedCount`, `removedCount`, `addedLines`, `removedLines`, `prices`, `priceChanges`, `keywordsPresent`, `keywordsAppeared`, `keywordsDisappeared`, `titleBefore`, `titleAfter`, `previousCheckAt`.
SUMMARY: `changed` (changed pages with summaries), `failed`, `counts`, `takeaway`, `nextStep`. Records: `CHANGES_XLSX` (Pages + every added/removed line), `PAGES_CSV`. Pages that can't be fetched are free.
Price: $0.0015 per page checked.

## Hidden AI Instructions Scanner (free)

URL: https://apify.com/pandadad0214/hidden-ai-instructions-scanner
MCP tool (this repo): `hidden_ai_instructions_scanner`
Use when: an agent is about to read a site it doesn't trust and you want to know if the page hides text from people but aims it at AI agents (prompt injection): CSS-hidden text, off-screen text, comments, alt/aria text, zero-width characters, content shown only to AI user agents.
Input: `urls` (required), `renderJs`, `agentUaDiff` (compare what a browser and an AI agent user agent get), `crawlDepth` (0 to 5), `settleSecs`, `maxPages` (1 to 1,000, default 50), `minSeverity` (low / medium / high), `timeoutSecs`.
Minimal input: `{"urls": ["https://example.com"]}`
Output per item: page summaries (`type: page-summary`, `url`, `verdict`, `findings`, `categories`, `topSeverity`, `techniques`, `agentSummary`) and findings with technique, location, excerpt and category (policy notice, manipulation, harmful).
SUMMARY: overall verdict and counts. Free: no per-result charge.
Price: free.

Price and delivery: from $15, 2-3 days (Basic package; larger packages available).
